day7_finale.speaker: The Boss
day7_finale.text: Final day. You've been useful... for the most part.

choices.text: What do you mean 'for the most part'?

finale.speaker: The Boss
finale.text: You sold our stock, but not enough of it. You've failed to meet quota...

youll_see.speaker: The Boss
youll_see.text: Should have met the quota. You'll see what happens now. Say goodbye.

goodbye.speaker: The Boss
goodbye.text: I've no time for pointless argue. You're done. Goodbye.
